idea: Simple ways to protect plumbing during renovation
title: How to Keep Renovation Debris Out of Your Pipes
description: During bathroom or kitchen remodeling, cement slurry, tile chips, and plaster dust frequently fall into uncovered waste pipes. Once inside, this heavy debris settles in drain traps, hardens like rock, and causes severe blockages that are expensive to clear later. A simple plastic pipe cap, expanding plug, or tightly taped cover costs very little, but saves you from breaking fresh tiles to fix blocked lines after work is complete. Always instruct your tiling and masonry workers to cap every open pipe before work begins.
image_prompt: A vertical 9:16 eye-level professional photograph of a residential bathroom under renovation. In the center foreground, a clean white 2-inch PVC waste pipe extends vertically 4 inches above a rough concrete subfloor. The open top of the pipe is capped tightly with a high-visibility yellow plastic pipe plug. Around the base of the pipe, the floor is covered in light cement dust, small ceramic tile chips, and sand grit. In the softly blurred background, a wall with light grey tiles and fresh grout lines is visible under natural daylight. Realistic textures of PVC plastic, rough cement floor, dry masonry dust, and smooth tile. Natural realistic interior lighting, sharp focus on the capped pipe, shallow depth of field, photorealistic shot on 35mm lens, no text, no words, no watermarks, no logos.
visual_story: The viewer sees a modern residential bathroom undergoing floor and wall tiling. On the concrete floor near a partially tiled wall, an open PVC drain pipe protrudes upward. The pipe top is sealed securely with a bright yellow protective cap. Gray tile dust, small stone chips, and dried mortar splatters rest on the floor around the pipe base, demonstrating how easily debris falls near open drains. The contrast between the dirty floor and the clean, capped pipe immediately highlights the protective measure.

on_image_text.explanation: Cover open pipe stubs to block cement and tile debris.
on_image_text.takeaway: Cap open pipes before demolition or tiling starts.
